title: Misalignment Between Educators' Testing and End Users' Behavior: What 17,000+ Chatbot Messages Reveal About AI Literacy Training for Teachers
abstract: arXiv:2611.28015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI literacy training for educators is expanding rapidly, but its effectiveness rests largely on self-report, knowledge tests, or interviews, revealing little about whether learning carries into practice or affects students and colleagues who use what educators build. We implemented AI for Learning, an asynchronous online course that trained 87 higher-education educators to recognize AI's capabilities, limitations, and ethics; apply prompt engineering; and evaluate AI outputs. Its central assignment asked educators to build, test, and voluntarily deploy chatbots for their practice on an educational chatbot authoring platform. Using LLM-assisted qualitative coding validated against human annotation, we analyzed the resulting 214 chatbots and their builder-bot, peer-bot, and end user-bot conversations, 17,000+ messages spanning 1.5 years. translated_title: 教育者测试与终端用户行为之间的错位：17,000+条聊天机器人消息对教师AI素养培训的启示
translated_abstract: 针对教育者的AI素养培训正在迅速扩展，但其有效性评估主要依赖自我报告、知识测试或访谈，很少揭示所学内容是否转化到实践中，或是否影响了使用教育者所构建工具的学生和同事。我们实施了“AI for Learning”这一异步在线课程，培训了87名高等教育教育者认识AI的能力、局限性与伦理，应用提示工程，并评估AI输出。该课程的核心作业要求教育者在一个教育聊天机器人创作平台上构建、测试并自愿部署用于其自身实践的聊天机器人。我们采用经人工标注验证的LLM辅助定性编码方法，分析了由此产生的214个聊天机器人及其构建者-机器人、同伴-机器人和终端用户-机器人之间的对话，共17,000+条消息，时间跨度达1.5年。研究发现，教育者1）更常指定机器人应该做什么，而非不应该做什么；2）倾向于采用模板化的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 通过分析87名教育者构建的214个聊天机器人在1.5年间产生的17,000+条对话消息，该研究揭示了教育者在测试聊天机器人时的行为与终端用户实际使用行为之间的错位，为超越自我报告和知识测试、真实评估教师AI素养培训效果提供了新方法。
en_tdlr: By analyzing 17,000+ messages across 214 chatbots built by 87 educators over 1.5 years, this study reveals a misalignment between educators' testing behavior and end users' actual usage patterns, offering a new lens for evaluating AI literacy training beyond self-reports and knowledge tests.
